rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent low ring/loop with a central void and a legible relation to the access edge, so it has a real museum-like public threshold and some precedent resonance. However, in the four-view set the form is still too generic and box-derived in section: the outer mass is mostly a simple extruded datum, while the inner carve does not yet produce a convincing gallery/public sequence or controlled-light section. The silhouette is only modestly resolved and is more of a shallow perimeter cut than a program-leading massing idea. Because the cultural brief requires a legible public sequence and void/light logic, the form is close but not yet fully program-fit.
